checks.2_caps: Plan caps: '1 file, 315 authored lines'. Measured wc -l on the committed blob = 314 lines, not 315. This is a real discrepancy between the plan's stated cap and the actual/committed file, but the PR body discloses it honestly and explains it correctly: 'the plan's stated line count is 315; the file as it exists in the root checkout and as committed here measures 314 lines by wc -l (confirmed with awk NR and a byte-level trailing-newline check)'. Independently reproduced: wc -l and awk 'END{print NR}' on the root-checkout file both return 314; the file ends with a single trailing newline (tail -c 5 shows '13/.\n', not a doubled or missing newline), so this is a genuine one-line difference from the plan's estimate, not a counting artifact. Total committed bytes via git cat-file -s = 45,542, matches PR body.

checks.4_prose_evidence_refs: Scanned PROGRESS.md for bare `evidence/...` path mentions in prose (not links): found ~19 distinct paths. Sampled 10: evidence/main-proof-index-20260915.json, evidence/equipment-loader-main-verification-20260912.json, evidence/hydration-safety-main-verification-20260912.json, evidence/infantry-main-verification.json, evidence/manifest-sync-main-verification-20260912.json, evidence/r0-contracts-completion-20260912.json, evidence/r0-documentation-readiness-parent-acceptance-20260913.json, evidence/r0-evidence-batch-plan-20260915.json, evidence/r0-publication-manifest-20260915.json, evidence/r1-remote-closure-20260915.json (all under openspec/planning/2026-09-12-roadmap-completion/). 9 of 10 resolve to a committed blob on one of the codex/roadmap-r0-publish-receipts-* branches (verified individually via git cat-file -e on each receipts branch): main-proof-index and r0-evidence-batch-plan and r1-remote-closure -> receipts-20260915-02; equipment-loader/hydration-safety/manifest-sync verifications -> receipts-20260912-01; infantry-main-verification -> receipts-undated-01; r0-contracts-completion -> receipts-20260912-02; r0-documentation-readiness-parent-acceptance -> receipts-20260913-01. The 10th, evidence/r0-publication-manifest-20260915.json, does not exist on origin/main or on any of the 11 receipts-batch branches -- but it is explicitly named in the plan's own `laterPrs` field as a file that ships in the still-uncreated 'publication-receipts' batch, which comes after every PR in the current 18-PR plan (including this one). PROGRESS.md's own text corroborates this is intentional: it explains that README.md carries no evidence links precisely because 'PROGRESS.md cites receipts in prose only', with the actual content living in the receipt batches. This is a forward-reference to a planned-but-not-yet-created artifact, not a broken link (PROGRESS.md has zero markdown links per item 3) and not a claim that the file currently exists.

Do not retry or export another way without its exact approval'), and canonical receipts are cited by evidence/ path, matching PUBLICATION.md's rule to record raw logs by hash rather than claim they are in Git.
